items.description: Copper pipe repair - fittings, pipe section, consumables
items.rationale: A heating pipe fracture inside the building is covered under 2.4.3(a) and the pipe is not part of the boiler. Material for the repair is a necessary repair cost under 7.1.7(c). One metre of copper pipe, new fittings and consumables is modest.
Labour at customary rates is indemnified under 7.1.7(g). About 1.5 days with a helper for part of it is plausible but may be slightly generous, so I used a moderate figure.
The insulation belonged to the repaired pipe section and had to be replaced, so it falls under the repair cost in 7.1.7(c). The covered quantity is only about 1 m, so the price is small.
One call-out or travel charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified under 7.1.7(f). Reference cases show these charges are small.
Disposal of the removed old pipe and insulation is covered under 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1. The waste is one small bag, so the price is low.
General administrative, handling or processing charges on top of itemised labour and materials are excluded under 7.1.8(b).

items.description: Tile cleaning, disinfection and coating 5 hrs
items.rationale: Cleaning and disinfecting is general cleanliness, not a repair cost (7.1.8(a)). Water from a heating pipe is not damage to the tiles, and the coating would be an improvement. The line is excluded.
